headline: Book on Filmmaker Awtar Kaul Presented at IFFI
summary: A new book documenting the life and legacy of filmmaker Awtar Kaul was featured at IFFI. Authored by Vinod Kaul, the book revisits the cinematic contributions of the late director known for '27 Down'.

headline: PWD Issues Fresh Traffic Advisory for Guirim Corridor
summary: The Public Works Department has issued a new traffic advisory for the Guirim elevated corridor. The notice clearly outlines the designated entry and exit points for commuters.

headline: Prasar Bharati Announces Script Pitching Lab Winners at IFFI
summary: Avishesh Jha won the top prize of ₹5 lakh for his script 'Mirchi Cake' at Prasar Bharati's 'Page Se Pitch Tak' pitching lab during IFFI in Panaji. Satya Vyas secured the second spot in the competition.

headline: Filmmakers Discuss Mythology and Superheroes at IFFI
summary: Directors Ayan Mukerji and Basil Joseph participated in an interactive session at the 57th IFFI in Goa. They explored ways to blend Indian mythology and folklore with superhero cinema and fantasy storytelling.

headline: Court Grants Bail to Accused in Karapur-Sarvan Clash
summary: The JMFC court in Bicholim has granted conditional bail to Sarvesh Dhawaskar following his arrest in connection with the Karapur-Sarvan clash. He was released on a personal bond of ₹15,000.

headline: Goa Opposition Alliance Talks at Advanced Stage, Says Yuri Alemao
summary: Leader of Opposition Yuri Alemao confirmed that discussions for an opposition alliance ahead of the 2027 Goa Assembly elections are progressing well. He expressed confidence that the coalition strategy will be finalized soon.

headline: Polish Tourist Dies After Collapsing on Arossim Beach
summary: A 66-year-old Polish tourist passed away after collapsing while walking on Arossim beach with his wife. He was rushed to the Cansaulim Primary Health Centre, where doctors declared him brought dead.

headline: Prime Accused in Excise Job Scam Surrenders to Panaji Police
summary: Ajit Shankhwalkar, the main accused in Goa's Excise Department cash-for-jobs scam, has surrendered after being evading police for over a month. He was taken into custody following a lookout notice issued earlier this month.

headline: Viral Tiger Video From Karnataka, Not Goa, Says Forest Minister
summary: Forest Minister Vishwajeet Rane clarified that a viral video showing a tiger was filmed in Karnataka and not Goa. The Forest Department confirmed the location after verifying the footage.

headline: Nitesh Tiwari’s 'Ramayana' Opens BRICS Film Section at IFFI
summary: Filmmaker Nitesh Tiwari's 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend (Part 1)' was selected as the official opening film for the 'Films from BRICS' segment at the 57th IFFI in Goa.
